text:
anya: hey team — noticed a short 4xx burst for /v1/generate around 14:03 UTC, a few customer errors. can someone point me to the dashboards/logs/traces to grab evidence? also getting noisy alert emails — would like a quick take on debounce/threshold change

observability-bot: [ALERT] route-4xx-rate (/v1/generate) triggered at 2026-03-16T14:03:05Z — 4xx rate = 2.8% over 5m (threshold 2.0%). incident id: obs-20260316-1403

sanjeev: quick links — grafana: https://grafana.redwood.net/d/obs/errors-by-route?var-route=%2Fv1%2Fgenerate ; logs: https://logs.redwood.net/search?q=path%3A%22%2Fv1%2Fgenerate%22&from=2026-03-16T13:55:00Z&to=2026-03-16T14:10:00Z ; traces (jaeger): https://jaeger.redwood.net/search?service=inference&operation=generate&start=2026-03-16T13:55&end=2026-03-16T14:10

sanjeev: sample logs query (our internal log UI accepts this):
```
status >= 400 AND http.path = "/v1/generate" | stats count() by status, http.user_agent | sort -count
```

sanjeev: also check the error-rate metric: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{path="/v1/generate",code=~"4.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{path="/v1/generate"}[5m]))` in Prometheus/Grafana to see the rolling ratio

maria: fyi i scanned the logs — ~60% of the 4xx have user_agent containing `okhttp` and a small spike of 429s. looks like a client retry loop from a partner integration. sample trace id I pulled: `1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h` (jaeger link above)

oncall: could you paste 2-3 trace ids + a couple of raw log lines? tracer will show whether upstream timeout or bad payload. if it's retries, we should consider client-ip aggregation in the alert so a single misbehaving client doesn't ring ops

anya: here are two trace ids from the logs: `1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h`, `9h8g7f6e5d4c3b2a`. raw log sample:
```
2026-03-16T14:02:58Z INFO req_id=abcd1234 path=/v1/generate status=429 user_agent="okhttp/4.9.1" upstream_latency_ms=12 client_ip=203.0.113.45
2026-03-16T14:03:01Z INFO req_id=efgh5678 path=/v1/generate status=400 user_agent="curl/7.79.1" error="invalid_prompt"
```

maria: thanks. for the noisy alert, two quick ops options: 1) increase debounce window from 5m -> 10m (reduces churn for short bursts) OR 2) keep 5m but change alert to top-5-client-ip weighted (so a single client won't trigger). my vote: debounce -> 10m, and add client-ip breakdown widget to the dash

oncall: +1 for debounce change for now. but let's not mask real regressions — if error type shifts to 5xx we should keep fast alerting. can we add a short temporary silence for the alert group while we triage (14:10-14:40)?

sanjeev: i can put a 30m silence on the alert group and then open a follow-up ticket to add client-ip aggregation and a 10m debounce PR. quick steps to reproduce (dev):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.local/v1/generate -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"prompt":"", "stream":false}'
```

maria: i'll draft the PR to change the alert rule and add the client-ip panel. will target a small rollout and a canary on staging first. assigning to @sanjeev for silence and @maria for PR, @anya can attach any extra traces to the ticket.

anya: thanks all — attaching the two trace links to the ticket now. will monitor for >10m. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks, I'll post the PR link when up :rocket:

oncall: closing loop — silence applied, keeping eyes on the dash. ping if you see re-trigger within the next 15m

sanjeev: noted. will follow up with ticket obs-4567 for the dashboard + alert improvement work.
